origin.description: A data frame indexed by a chosen set of rows.

arguments.name: idx
arguments.text: 1-based integer row indexes. Repeats are kept.

origin.details: The printed size uses the length of idx and the number of columns, so ten indexes into mtcars print as 10 by 11.
